netlist:
* circuit-tutor netlist
.include models/tl072.lib
C1 b1_n_a b1_out 8.2e-7
C2 b1_n_b 0 8.2e-7
R1 b1_in b1_n_a 1.2e4
R2 b1_n_a b1_n_b 1.3e4
R3 b1_out 0 1e4
XU1_A b1_n_b b1_out vcc vee b1_out TL072
V1 b1_in 0 DC 0e0 AC 1e0 SIN(0e0 1e0 1e1)
Vrail_vcc vcc 0 DC 1.5e1
Vrail_vee vee 0 DC -1.35e1
.options reltol=1e-3 gmin=1e-12
.save all @c1[i] @c2[i] @r1[i] @r2[i] @r3[i]
.op
.tran 5e-4 5e-1
.ac dec 50 1e-1 1e3
.meas ac b1_fc_hz_ref find vdb(b1_out) at=1e0
.meas ac b1_fc_hz_x when vdb(b1_out)=b1_fc_hz_ref-3 fall=1
.meas ac b1_q_f0 when vp(b1_out)=-1.5707963267948966e0 fall=1
.meas ac b1_q_ref find vdb(b1_out) at=b1_q_f0/10
.meas ac b1_q_g0 find vdb(b1_out) at=b1_q_f0
.end
